chunks: Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
The people of Makkah complete the salat (prayer) at ʿArafāt,
He said: "Woe to them, or alas for them! And what journey is more serious than it? No, it is not to be completed."

key_terms.بِعَرَفَاتٍ: at ʿArafāt during the pilgrimage journey
key_terms.يُتِمُّونَ: they perform in full rather than shortening

ai.seo_question: Should the people of Makkah complete or shorten their salat (prayer) at ʿArafāt?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the salat (prayer) of travelers at ʿArafāt. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام rejects the practice of the people of Makkah completing the prayer there, indicating that the ruling of shortened prayer applies on this journey.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1301 - Muawiya ibn Ammar said to Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as):
"The people of Mecca complete (perform in full) their prayers at Arafat."
He (as) replied: "Woe to them! (Or, Alas for them!) What journey is more significant than this? No, it should not be completed”.
